presets.name: Pad under the voice
presets.desc: Lowers an ambient guitar pad by 9 dB while the singer sings, holding through the gaps between words
presets.notes: Key = the voice lane's DI. The key filters keep breath and stage rumble out; set thresh just above the mic's bleed at soundcheck

presets.name: Voice band carve
presets.desc: Cuts 8 dB from a pad only in a two-octave band around 1.5 kHz while the voice sings; the body stays
presets.notes: The pad keeps its loudness and lows; only the band the voice needs moves out of the way

presets.name: Spectral vocal space
presets.desc: Ducks a keys or synth bed by 8 dB only in the half-octave bands where the voice is loudest, moment by moment
presets.notes: 16 bells from 57 Hz to 10 kHz; spread 12 dB ducks the voice's formant regions and leaves the rest of the bed alone

presets.name: Solo spotlight
presets.desc: Makes room in the centre of a stereo backing for a band mate's solo, in its own bands; the width stays
presets.notes: Key = the soloist's lane output (needs golem's key_from). Mid only: the backing's side signal is untouched

presets.name: Talkover, mids
presets.desc: Pulls the music's midrange down 18 dB while the talk mic is used; bass and air stay up
presets.notes: Hold 600 ms bridges the pauses of speech; the 3-octave bell is the band of a speaking voice

presets.name: Talkover, full band
presets.desc: Lowers the whole music by 18 dB while the talk mic is used, back up a second after the last word
presets.notes: The broadcast talkover: a fixed depth whatever the level of the voice

presets.name: Talkback button
presets.desc: A footswitch that drops the signal by 18 dB while held, for talking to the band or the room
presets.notes: Duck Now on a momentary footswitch does the work; thresh 0 dB keeps any key from ducking. Never stored with Duck Now on

presets.name: Delay tail out of the way
presets.desc: On a wet-only branch: the repeats drop 12 dB while you play and swell back in the gaps
presets.notes: Works today: golem keys the block with the lane's DI. Knee 6 dB gives gfx-delay's own ducking curve, for effects without one

presets.name: Reverb tail out of the way
presets.desc: On a wet-only reverb branch: the wash sinks 10 dB under the playing and blooms when you stop
presets.notes: A slower return than the delay preset: the bloom rises over 600 ms instead of jumping back

presets.name: Kick ducks the sub
presets.desc: Each kick fires the same short 12 dB dip on the bass's lows only; the growl above 240 Hz stays
presets.notes: Key = the kick (needs golem's key_from). Level-independent dips; for a kick mic with bass bleed use hpf 2000 on the beater's click

presets.name: Kick ducks the sub, in time
presets.desc: Each kick dips the bass's lows 12 dB for 70 % of an eighth note, the recovery locked to the tempo
presets.notes: The recovery follows the song's tempo, so it never needs retuning between songs

presets.name: Club pump
presets.desc: The sidechain pump on every beat without a kick: a fast 18 dB dip that swells back late
presets.notes: Phase from the host's position: the dip lands on the beat. Positive tension keeps the gain low and returns it late

presets.name: Low-only pump
presets.desc: Pumps only the lows of a pad or clean chords on each beat, 24 dB deep; the top stays bright
presets.notes: A band split without a crossover: the shelf is out of the path between dips, so the top is never touched

presets.name: Half-time breathing
presets.desc: A gentle 6 dB dip every half note that snaps back early: the pad breathes with the groove
presets.notes: Negative tension returns the gain early and lands softly on 0 dB

presets.name: Clean deep duck, lookahead
presets.desc: Ducks 15 dB with a 5 ms fall that completes as the key's onset arrives: no tick on low sustained notes
presets.notes: 5 ms of reported latency: a studio or setup choice, not for live monitoring through the block
